results.title: Lexo
results.overview: In the music world the outstanding pianist Alexander Toradze (1952–2022) is also known as Lexo, as he was often called by his relatives, friends, and colleagues. He graduated from the Moscow Conservatoire in 1977. In the 1980’s, he emigrated to the USA, taught at Indiana University, and later launched his own piano studio. Toradze was a brilliant interpreter of the works of Shostakovich, Mussorgsky, Scryabin, and Stravinsky. The recordings of Prokofiev’s concertos performed by Alexander Toradze with the Mariinsky Theater Orchestra conducted by Valery Gergiev are considered a gold standard. The pianist also appeared frequently with leading orchestras of Europe and the USA.

results.title: Lioness
results.overview: When the temperamental Sylvie (17) is told that she has to give up her child when it’s born, she decides to escape the youth institution where she’s placed. In her eyes it’s the only solution to prevent that her child will have the same institutionalized youth as she endured.

results.title: Innes Lloyd: The Producer
results.overview: A look at the life and work of television producer Innes Lloyd

results.title: Mantis
results.overview: Inside an apartment in Milan, two gay boys talk about their feelings towards dating apps.

results.title: Carrousel
results.overview: In one of the most polluted regions of France, a small industrial town by the Mediterranean Sea lives in striking contrast, where smokestacks loom and super tankers drift by, yet people swim, dance, and savour life. Amid the haze of factories and the hum of semi-trailers, a resilient community clings to joy and routine. At the edge of the freeway, Natalie’s food truck has stood for thirty years, serving as a symbol of perseverance and humanity. This visually rich, emotionally resonant film captures the paradox of living between industrial ruin and natural beauty, where survival means choosing not to look right at the smoke, but left, towards the sea.

results.title: Odum Kuthira Chadum Kuthira
results.overview: Jilted at his wedding, Aby encounters a reserved woman needing help. As they heal together, his ex returns with newfound insight into his dreams. A hidden truth leads Aby to find peace.

results.title: Infernal Beeping
results.overview: After his smoke alarm runs out of batteries, Edgar battles a constant beeping and his own sanity in a journey to go back to sleep.

results.title: Cascas
results.overview: In the cemetery of images, a fox wanders above the Klipot, in which lie industrial memories of life and death.

results.title: Joe
results.overview: Hiding in an empty house on the Norfolk coast, a tormented young man is hunted by a relentless enemy and haunted by the ghost of a lost love. As the voice of the river and the presence of a dead whale pull him deeper into memory, he must face the past—and the fate he cannot escape.

results.title: The Air We Breathe
results.overview: In a near-future Scotland, the air is so polluted you have to pay to breathe. Disillusioned activist Eliza prepares for a final act of protest against the oxygen company who destroyed her life.

results.title: Maria
results.overview: Manuella wakes up after a drunken evening. To her great surprise, Maria disappeared. Panicked and hungover, she sets out to search for Maria through the town of Carpentras.

results.title: Redruth Market Day Americano Apocalypse
results.overview: Why is ordering coffee so complicated?  Originally written for o-region's From The Horse's Mouth Project.  WINNER Best Actor Cornwall Monologue Competition 2025  WINNER Best Cinematography Cornwall Monologue Competition 2025

results.title: Fasting Love
results.overview: Jisu, a virtual YouTuber with a dream of becoming a singer, hides her face and performs under an avatar. After passing the first round of an audition, she decides to lose weight quickly for the next stage and enters the strict Seonnyeo Fasting Center. On her way there, she meets a man who resembles her ideal type. However, the fasting center's rules are tough, and she constantly clashes with the grumpy manager, Yunho. Amidst hunger, the tempting smell of grilled pork wafts from a nearby restaurant owned by the man she met, leading Jisu into a moral struggle between temptation and her dream of becoming a singer.

results.title: Cohousing
results.overview: When a headstrong teen with dreams of the big city finds out that a developer wants to buy her neighborhood, she must convince her wacky cohousing community to sell, in order to get the cash to finance her goals.

results.title: Germán Araújo
results.overview: In Germán Araujo, director Aldo Novick revives the memory of a journalist who defied censorship during one of Uruguay's darkest periods. Through previously unseen archival footage, testimonies, and music, the film honors the courage of those who reported the truth when it was risky. This powerful documentary is shaping up to be one of the most important Uruguayan film releases of the year.

results.title: Taiping Zhen Strange Tales
results.overview: Set in the Republican era, a string of bizarre murders plunges the town of Taiping into fear and panic. Whispers among the locals blame vengeful spirits seeking lives. But psychic detective Qin Mu, together with a young shamaness, uncovers a very human truth behind the legends—the elusive figure known as Golden Swallow. Drawing on sharp investigative instincts and exceptional analytical skills, they unravel the mystery behind Taiping’s gruesome killings, expose a tragic case buried five years earlier, and restore justice and peace to the troubled town.

results.title: Dark Secrets
results.overview: Two lifelong best friends uncover a hidden truth about a long-buried murder. and more But as secrets unravel and trust shatters, they realize the real danger isn't what they found - it's what one of them has been hiding all along with a child hood game called dark secrets they begin to reveal some of their darkest secrets.
